Q: Mysql, set the default unix time A:

UNIX_TIMESTAMP cannot be used as default value for your INTEGER columns. You must use an expression as default value, for that purposes the function call must be enclosed with the parenthesis:

CREATE TABLE ... ( ...
    `time` INT DEFAULT UNIX_TIMESTAMP   -- will generate syntax error
    `time` INT DEFAULT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP) -- will be executed successfully
    ...

Q: FFmpeg ignores bitrate A:

-b:v only affects the video bitrate. For some reason ffmpeg defaults to using the flac audio codec for .ogv output (at least in some versions). In this case the flac audio will be even larger than your video.

Assuming you wanted vorbis audio, use the option -codec:a libvorbis (or -acodec libvorbis in some versions) before the output file name to specify this. You may also want to specify a bitrate for the audio, e.g. -b:a 32k (or -ba 32k). If you want the total bitrate to be 128kbps, specify audio and video bitrates that add up to a total of 128k (or a little less if you want to compensate for the ogg container overhead).

Q: Extracting date from text in Google sheets A:

How to extract the date, there are two options:

  1. Using REGEXEXTRACT. With the formula that player0 has provided, you take the numbers that are between the first two /:

    =REGEXEXTRACT(A1, "\d+/\d+/\d+")

  2. Using FIND, MID and TRIM

    • Use FIND to get the positions of the first two blank spaces:
      • B1 = FIND(" ", A1) - position of first blank space
      • B2 = FIND(" ", A1, B1+1) - the last parameter indicates the character where the search starts
      • RESULT = TRIM(MID(A1, B1, B2-B1)) - how the formula looks like with intermediate calculations. With MID you take B2-B1 characters from a string starting on the B1 position. TRIM just emoves leading, trailing spaces.
      • FINAL RESULT = TRIM(MID(A1,FIND(" ",A1),FIND(" ",A1,FIND(" ",A1)+1)-FIND(" ",A1)))

How to deal with more cells with different value types

  1. Using SWITCH
    • First argument: cell with the text
    • Second and third: condition and value if TRUE
    • Four and five: second condition if needed, you can use multiple conditions
    • Last one: default value
    =SWITCH(A1, "", "BLANK CELL", "OFF", "OFF CELL", 
REGEXEXTRACT(A1, "\d+/\d+/\d+"))
    or 
    =SWITCH(A1, "", "BLANK CELL", "OFF", "OFF CELL", 
TRIM(MID(A1,FIND(" ",A1),FIND(" ",A1,FIND(" ",A1)+1)-FIND(" ",A1))))

Q: The Anaconda launcher takes long time to load A:

I started Anaconda Navigator with "Run as Administrator" privileges on my Windows machine, and it worked like a charm. Though it did ask me for Admin credentials for a couple of times while loading different scripts, but the response was <1 min, compared to 6 - 8 mins. earlier.

Search for Anaconda through desktop search or go to Cortana tool on the desktop toolbar and type Anaconda On the Anaconda icon that shows up, right-click and choose "Run as Administrator" Provide Admin credentials when prompted This should hopefully work for Windows 10 users.

Q: Hortonworks HA Namenodes gives an error "Operation category READ is not supported in state standby" A:

I had the same issue. You need to update the client libraries. Use amabari to set up spark and have it install the client on the server. Then set your SPARK_HOME environment variable.

Q: InfoPath Forms Services is not turned on A:

Have you tried this:

  1. Go to Central Administration > Operations > Enable Features on existing sites
  2. Tick the check box "Enable all sites..."
